messages.raw: §fNot everything in this world is immediately obvious.
messages.text: Not everything in this world is immediately obvious.
messages.zh: 这个世界并非所有事情都一目了然。

messages.raw: §fI've dedicated my life to collecting all the information I can about this place.
messages.text: I've dedicated my life to collecting all the information I can about this place.
messages.zh: 我毕生都在尽力收集有关这里的一切信息。

messages.zh: 留意头顶带有⚑ 指南 标记的人。他们通常掌握着有用的信息!
